course_name_original: Redacción de textos científico-técnicos en Inglés
course_name_en: Scientific and Technical Writing in English

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, making correct use of language, in writing.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, making correct use of language orally.

teaching_methods: Completion of individual and team exercises
Individual and team computer simulation practices

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
Team oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
